brief:
Sliman Mansour, a founding figure of the Palestinian art movement, built a body of work and artistic community devoted to Palestinian causes across decades, Mondoweiss reported. A friend and fellow artist recalled Mansour's role in establishing the movement alongside colleagues, noting his unwavering commitment even as his health deteriorated. Mansour's work and mentorship helped define Palestinian artistic expression and resistance through visual culture.

The artist's legacy centers on his refusal to separate his creative practice from political engagement. His colleagues credited him with helping construct an infrastructure for Palestinian artists to work and exhibit, creating pathways for generations to follow. Mansour maintained his devotion to Palestine throughout his life, embedding that commitment into both his own practice and the broader artistic movement he helped establish.
dek: A friend and fellow artist remembers Sliman Mansour, who helped build the Palestinian art movement and, even as his health failed, never let go of his devotion to Palestine.
title: Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour shaped movement through decades of commitment.
